name: Fey Disciple
body:
The children of the woods, descendants of faerie creatures or born from eldritch energies and spells, become one with the First World when they mature.

Requirements

To qualify to become a fey disciple, a character must fulfill all the following criteria.

Race: Cannot be a creature of the fey type, the fey-blooded subtype, or have a template with “fey”, “first world”, or “faerie” in its name.
Skills: Knowledge (nature) 5 ranks.
Languages: Sylvan.
Spellcasting: Able to cast at least one among entangle, hideous laughter, or summon nature’s ally I. A sorcerer or bloodrager with this prestige class must have the fey bloodline. If the character gains levels of sorcerer or bloodrager after taking this class, she must take the fey bloodline
Class Skills

The fey disciple’s class skills are Bluff (Cha), Diplomacy (Cha), Fly (Dex), Knowledge (nature) (Int), Perform (Cha), Perception (Wis), Stealth (Dex), and Use Magic Device (Cha).

Skill Ranks at Each Level: 2 + Int modifier.

Hit Die: d6.

Table: Fey Disciple
Level	Base Attack Bonus	Fort Save	Ref Save	Will Save	Special	Spells per Day
1st	+0	+0	+1	+0	Faerie blood, natural armor increase +1	+1 level of existing spellcasting class
2nd	+1	+1	+1	+1	Ability boost (Dex +2), bloodline feat	+1 level of existing spellcasting class
3rd	+1	+1	+2	+1	Fey boon, fey shape (1/day)	+1 level of existing spellcasting class
4th	+2	+1	+2	+1	Ability boost (Dex +2), natural armor increase +2	+1 level of existing spellcasting class
5th	+2	+2	+3	+2	Bloodline feat, low-light vision	+1 level of existing spellcasting class
6th	+3	+2	+3	+2	Ability boost (Int +2), fey boon	+1 level of existing spellcasting class
7th	+3	+2	+4	+2	Fey shape (2/day), natural armor increase +3	+1 level of existing spellcasting class
8th	+4	+3	+4	+3	Ability boost (Cha +2), bloodline feat	+1 level of existing spellcasting class
9th	+4	+3	+5	+3	Faerie magic, fey boon	+1 level of existing spellcasting class
10th	+5	+3	+5	+3	Fey shape (3/day), darkvision 30 ft.	+1 level of existing spellcasting class
Class Features

All of the following are class features of the fey disciple prestige class.

Weapon and Armor Proficiency

Fey disciples gain no proficiency with any weapon or armor.

Spells per Day

When a new fey disciple level is gained, the character gains new spells per day as if she had also gained a level in a spellcasting class she belonged to before adding the prestige class. She does not, however, gain other benefits a character of that class would have gained, except for additional spells per day, spells known (if she is a spontaneous spellcaster), and an increased effective level of spellcasting. If a character had more than one spellcasting class before becoming a fey disciple, she must decide to which class she adds the new level for purposes of determining spells per day.

Faerie Blood

A fey disciple adds her level to her sorcerer or bloodrager levels when determining the powers gained from her bloodline. A character with levels in both bloodrager and sorcerer must choose which class stacks with her fey disciple levels to determine his bloodline powers. If she does not have levels in sorcerer or bloodrager, she instead gains bloodline powers of the fey sorcerer bloodline, using her fey disciple level as her sorcerer level to determine the bonuses gained. This ability does not grant bonus spells to a sorcerer or bloodrager unless she possesses spell slots of an appropriate level. Such bonus spells are automatically granted if the sorcerer or bloodrager gains spell slots of the spell’s level.

Natural Armor Increase (Ex)

At 1st, 4th, and 7th level, a fey disciple’s skin toughens, causing a cumulative increase to her natural armor bonus of +1.

Ability Boost

As her body becomes more graceful and agile, a fey disciple gains stat boosts as noted on Table 12: Fey Disciple. These increases stack and are gained as if through level advancement.

Bloodline Feat

Upon reaching 2nd level, and every three levels thereafter, a fey disciple receives one bonus feat, chosen from the sorcerer fey bloodline’s bonus feat list or from the bloodrager fey bloodline’s bonus feat list, depending on which one she is advancing with her level progression.

Fey Boon: At 3rd level, and again at 6th and 9th level, a fey disciple gains a fey boon, a special ability that grants her some of the powers of a real fey. Each boon can only be chosen once unless noted otherwise.

Blurring Movement (Su)

The fey disciple gains the blurring movement ability of the fey bloodrager bloodline, even if she does not normally possess that power. Once her level is high enough to grant this ability through the bloodline, the fey disciple stays blurred for a full minute after the end of her movement. A fey disciple must be at least 6th level and have the bloodrage class ability to select this boon.

Bonus Feat

The fey disciple gains a bonus bloodline feat.

If the disciple belongs to a class that grants bonus feats as a class feature, she can instead gain a bonus feat of that type, stacking her fey disciple levels and her levels in that class for the purpose of meeting the feat’s prerequisites.

Camouflage (Ex)

The fey disciple can use Stealth to hide in any sort of natural terrain, even if the terrain does not grant cover or concealment. She gains a +4 racial bonus on Stealth checks. This bonus does not stack with any other Stealth bonus from other sources possessed by the fey disciple.

Change Shape (Su)

The fey disciple can change shape into a single form. Possible forms include a normal specimen of her race, a humanoid creature within one size category, or an animal within one size category. In all cases, the fey disciple appears as the same individual of her alternate form each time she changes shape. The type of polymorph spell used should be chosen as appropriate based on the alternate form, such as alter self for taking humanoid form. This boon can be selected more than once, granting an additional form each time.

Companion Bond (Ex)

The fey disciple’s class levels stack with levels in all classes that grant an animal companion for the purpose of determining her animal companion’s abilities. If the fey disciple possesses an animal companion through the sylvan bloodline, she instead uses her full sorcerer level plus her fey disciple level to determine her companion’s abilities.

Confusing Critical (Su)

The fey disciple gains the confusing critical ability of the fey bloodrager bloodline, even if she doesn’t normally possess that power. If she already possesses confusing critical through her bloodline, the effect lasts instead for a number of rounds equal to her Charisma bonus.

A fey disciple must have the bloodrage class ability to select this boon.

Energy Resistance (Ex)

The fey disciple gains resistance 10 to one energy type, or increases an existing resistance by 10.

Resistance increased beyond 30 becomes immunity instead.

A fey disciple must be at least 6th level to select this boon. It can be selected more than once.

Evasion (Ex)

The fey disciple gains evasion, as the rogue ability of the same name.

Fey Fascination (Su)

The fey disciple gains the fey fascination ability of the dark fey bloodline, even if she doesn’t normally possess that power. If she already possesses fey fascination through her bloodline, the effect lasts instead for a number of rounds equal to her Charisma bonus.

Fey Wings (Su)

The fey disciple gains the fey wings ability of the sylvan bloodline, even if she doesn’t normally possess that power. Once her level is high enough to grant this ability through the bloodline, the fey disciple’s fly speed increases by 30 feet and she can choose not to shrink her size when she uses this ability. A fey disciple must be at least 9th level to select this boon.

First World Affinity (Ex)

The fey disciple gains a bonus feat chosen among the following: Faerie’s Strike, Fey Insight, Fey Performance, Fey Spell Lore, Fey Spell Versatility, Fey-Guarded, Leaf Singer, Primal Ancestry, Spirit Beacon (fey), Spirit Rebuke (fey), Spirit Sight. She has to meet the feat’s prerequisites. This boon can be selected more than once.

Fleeting Glance (Sp)

The fey disciple gains the fleeting glance ability of the fey sorcerer bloodline, even if she doesn’t normally possess that power. Once her level is high enough to grant this ability through the bloodline, the fey disciple’s invisibility can extend to other creatures too, as per the greater invisibility spell’s description. A fey disciple must be at least 6th level to select this boon.

Greensight (Su)

The fey disciple gains greensight with a range of 60 feet. If she already possessed greensight, she instead adds 30 feet to its range.

Laughing Touch (Sp)

The fey disciple gains the laughing touch ability of the fey sorcerer bloodline, even if she doesn’t normally possess that power. If she already possesses laughing touch through her bloodline, the effect lasts instead for a number of rounds equal to her Charisma bonus.

Long Step (Su)

The fey disciple can teleport up to 10 feet per level as a move action. She may use this ability once per day, or twice per day if she is 7th-level or more. If the fey disciple possesses the whimsical step revelation from the whimsy oracle mystery, she instead stacks her fey disciple levels with her oracle levels for the purpose of using the revelation.

Trackless Step (Ex)

The fey disciple does not leave a trail in natural surroundings and cannot be tracked. She can choose to leave a trail, if she so desires.

Verdant Step (Su)

Three times per day, the fey disciple can transport herself from one tree to another tree, as tree stride with half the transport range. Moving from one tree to another in this manner is a move action. If the fey disciple possesses the one with nature ability of the fey bloodrager bloodline, she can instead use it one additional time per day.

A fey disciple must be at least 9th level to select this boon.

Woodland Stride (Ex)

The fey disciple can move through any sort of undergrowth (such as natural thorns, briars, overgrown areas, and similar terrain) at her normal speed and without taking damage or suffering any other impairment.

Thorns, briars, and overgrown areas that have been magically manipulated to impede motion still affect her. Optionally, this ability may function in a different type of terrain, to allow the fey disciple to move through, swamps, rocky areas, ice, and so forth. Whatever the choice, this ability only functions in one type of terrain. This boon can be selected more than once, for a different terrain each time.

Low-Light Vision (Ex)

At 5th level, the fey disciple gains low-light vision. If she already possessed it, she instead gains darkvision with a range of 30 feet, or increases the range of her existing darkvision by 30 feet. At 10th level, the fey disciple gains darkvision with a range of 30 feet or adds another 30 feet to her darkvision range.

Fey Shape (Sp)

At 3rd level, a fey disciple can assume some characteristics of fey once per day. This ability works like fey form I. At 7th level, this ability functions as fey form II and can be used twice per day; at 10th level, it functions as fey form III and the fey disciple can use this ability three times per day. Her caster level for this effect is equal to her effective sorcerer or bloodrager levels for her fey bloodline. If the fey disciple already has the ability to transform into a fey (as with a progenitor druid’s fey shape ability), she can instead use it one more time per day.

Faerie Magic (Su)

At 9th level, a fey disciple adds 2 spells from the druid list for every level she is able to cast (0-level included) to her list of spells known. She also can cast the fey boon and fey blight spells as if she were one of the fey races mentioned in the spells’ descriptions. The fey disciple must select which fey race’s boon and blight she can grant with these spells. Once made, the choice is set.
